name: code-writer
description: Claude Code config for Python and TypeScript projects. Constitution, spec-driven workflow skills with gates (plan, analyze, implement, review), verification-first definition of done, reviewer subagents, and mechanical hooks that read the repo's own command map. Python layer: tooling, code and testing rules. TypeScript layer: tooling, code, testing and optional framework rules and destructive-command patterns. Both have a dependency-manager guard and an opt-in formatter.
